# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and System Information

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" as the application name.
- **Date and Time**: "Oct 23 02:04" is shown in the center of the title bar.
- **System Notification Icon**: A bell icon is visible next to the date and time.
- **Window Control Buttons**: Located on the far right of the title bar, including minimize, maximize, and close buttons.
- **Desktop Environment Indicator**: "Activities" is visible on the far left of the title bar, indicating the GNOME desktop environment.

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: From left to right: File, Edit, Selection, View, Go, Run, Terminal, Help.
- **Active Menu**: The "Terminal" menu is currently open, displaying its dropdown options.

## Terminal Menu Dropdown

- **Menu Options**:
  - New Terminal (with shortcut Ctrl+Shift+`)
  - Split Terminal (with shortcut Ctrl+Shift+5)
  - Run Task...
  - Run Build Task... (with shortcut Ctrl+Shift+B)
  - Run Active File
  - Run Selected Text
  - Show Running Tasks...
  - Restart Running Task...
  - Terminate Task...
  - Configure Tasks...
  - Configure Default Build Task...

## Left Sidebar (Explorer Panel)

- **Panel Title**: "EXPLORER" is displayed at the top.
- **Folder Structure**:
  - USER folder is expanded, showing subdirectories and files:
    - .cache
    - .config
    - .gnupg
    - .ipython
    - .local
    - .mozilla
    - .pki
    - .ssh
    - .thunderbird
    - .var
    - .vscode
    - Desktop
    - Documents
    - Downloads
    - Music
    - Pictures
    - project
    - Public
    - server
    - snap
    - Templates
    - Videos
  - Additional files:
    - .bash_history
    - .bash_logout
    - .bashrc
    - .lesshst
    - .profile
    - .selected_editor
    - .sudo_as_admin_successful
    - .viminfo
    - requirement.txt
- **File Icons**: Files are marked with icons indicating their type (e.g., text files, configuration files).

## Main Content Area

- **Welcome Page**: Displays "Welcome - user - Visual Studio Code" at the top.
- **Walkthroughs Section**:
  - "Get Started with VS Code" with the subtitle "Customize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding".
  - "The Fundamentals" is listed below.
- **Recent Section**: Shows "project" as a recent item.

## Trust Folder Dialog

- **Dialog Title**: "Do you trust the authors of the files in this folder?"
- **Description Text**:
  - "Code provides features that may automatically execute files in this folder."
  - "If you don't trust the authors of these files, we recommend to continue in restricted mode as the files may be malicious. See our docs to learn more."
  - Path: "/home/user"
- **Checkbox Option**:
  - "Trust the authors of all files in the parent folder 'home'"
- **Action Buttons**:
  - "No, I don't trust the authors" (with tooltip "Browse folder in restricted mode")
  - "Yes, I trust the authors" (with tooltip "Trust folder and enable all features")
- **Additional Option**:
  - "Show welcome page on startup" with a downward arrow indicating it can be expanded or collapsed.

## Bottom Panel (Activity Bar)

- **Tabs**: PROBLEMS, OUTPUT, DEBUG CONSOLE, TERMINAL, PORTS.
- **Active Tab**: TERMINAL is currently selected.
- **Toolbar Icons**: Located to the right of the tabs, including:
  - Plus sign (+)
  - Downward arrow (↓)
  - Split icon (□)
  - Trash icon (🗑️)
  - Upward arrow (↑)
  - X (close)

## Status Bar

- **Left Side**:
  - Source control icon (branch icon)
  - Zero indicators for problems, warnings, and errors.
- **Right Side**:
  - "Screen Reader Optimized" text.
  - Accessibility icon (screen reader icon).

## Left Dock (Application Launcher)

- **Icons**:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code (active)
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - Files (file manager)
  - Software Center
  - Help (question mark)
  - Trash

## Bottom Dock (System Tray)

- **Grid Icon**: Located
